semiconductor_relevance: High — Pfeiffer Vacuum provides essential vacuum technology and measurement equipment critical for semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: Pfeiffer Vacuum+Fab Solutions specializes in turbomolecular and dry vacuum pumps, as well as measurement equipment tailored for semiconductor applications such as PVD, CVD, and lithography. They also offer leak detection systems and custom components, supporting contamination management in cleanroom environments.
capabilities: Turbomolecular vacuum pumps for PVD and CVD processes
Dry vacuum pumps for semiconductor manufacturing
Measurement equipment for inspection and metrology
Leak detection systems for contamination management

regional_presence.India: Pfeiffer Vacuum operates in India, providing localized support and solutions for the semiconductor industry.
